purpose: Source copy and design decisions for the existing roadmap. The keys identify handoff records only. The iOS app owns its display model and identifiers.

entries.title: Terraforming
entries.playerSummary: A planned Terraforming spell will let you lay dirt patches, rows of soil, and cobblestone circles beneath your forest objects.
entries.currentState: Approved art and ground pilot in draft PR. The spell and the Ground store and inventory gate are future app work.
entries.proposedUnlock: Learn the Terraforming spell to reveal Ground in Store and Inventory and enable ground purchases and placement.
unresolved: Individual ground acquisition and pricing after the spell

entries.title: Familiars
entries.playerSummary: A planned Familiars unlock will introduce forest animals, starting with a cow. Autumn and winter coats are planned for their seasonal packs.
entries.currentState: Approved base, autumn and winter art in the draft animal pilot. The Animals store and inventory gate is future app work.
entries.proposedUnlock: Familiars opens the Animals section in Store and Inventory. A spell and an achievement are both under consideration.
unresolved: How the cow is acquired and any price after the category opens

entries.title: Village Hut
entries.playerSummary: A Village achievement is being considered for the hut. Once the hut is accessible, an eligible seasonal pack can change its appearance.
entries.currentState: Disabled landmark on main with base, autumn and winter artwork. No live Village unlock is documented.
entries.proposedUnlock: Village achievement, provisionally named. Eligible owned packs select the hut artwork after object access.
unresolved: Direct reward or store availability after achievement

entries.title: Gold Vein
entries.playerSummary: A cluster of golden crystals is planned as a forest landmark. Its unlock is being considered as a spell or achievement.
entries.currentState: Approved base artwork. Disabled landmark in draft PR.
entries.proposedUnlock: A Gold Vein achievement or spell. The same artwork is used year-round.

entries.title: Silver Vein
entries.playerSummary: A silver outcrop is planned as a year-round forest landmark, with its own spell or achievement under consideration.
entries.currentState: Approved base artwork. Disabled landmark in draft PR.
entries.proposedUnlock: A Silver Vein achievement or spell. The same artwork is used year-round.

entries.title: Bronze Vein
entries.playerSummary: A bronze outcrop is planned for the forest. Its own spell or achievement would give players access to the landmark.
entries.currentState: Approved base artwork. Disabled landmark in draft PR.
entries.proposedUnlock: A Bronze Vein achievement or spell. The same artwork is used year-round.

entries.title: Cherry Blossom Tree
entries.playerSummary: A flowering cherry tree is planned for the forest. How players will collect it is still open.
entries.currentState: Base artwork approved. Tree disabled in draft PR. Seasonal designs await art approval.
unresolved: Approval and scheduling of seasonal art

entries.title: Classic Retro Collection
entries.playerSummary: A planned Classic Retro appearance pack would bring back the original forest sprites. Its unlock timing is still open.
entries.currentState: Originals archived on main. The pack key is proposed and has no catalog entry.
unresolved: How selection interacts with seasonal packs

entries.title: Winter Art Pack
entries.playerSummary: Winter looks are planned for forest objects including the Village Hut and cow. How the pack becomes available is still open.
entries.currentState: Pack is disabled on main. Hut artwork is on main. Cow artwork is in draft PR 4.
